text:
Alex Chen: Morning handoff — quick notes before I sign out at 11:30 PT.
- Rolling config tweak: reduced prefetch window from 6 -> 4 for /v1/generate to reduce spikey token costs. Deployed to canary at 02:15 UTC. No errors in logs so far.
Maria Vega: thanks. any perf/regression metrics to watch?
Alex Chen: watch latency P95 for canary nodes (/metrics/latency/p95) and token rate. I'll annotate canary tag as `canary/prefetch-4`.
Samir Patel: pinged in perf dash. FYI I added an alert: `canary-prefetch-p95 > 450ms for 5m` -> Pager only if > 10% of baseline.
oncall-bot: scheduled maintenance notice: gpu-pool-7 maintenance at 2026-03-19T03:00:00Z (30m). No deploys allowed during window.
Alex Chen: note: gpu-pool-7 hosts Dedicated for AcmeCorp. If you have long-running jobs, migrate or pause them pre-window.
Maria Vega: quick FYI — two PRs to watch: #3421 (kv-cache eviction fix) and #3430 (rbac token rotation). Both in review; KV patch landed to staging, watch for elevated eviction logs.
Samir Patel: saw a tiny uptick in evictions last night around 23:40 UTC. Not sure cause — might be prefetch change interaction.
Alex Chen: small troubleshooting command if you need logs quickly:
```
# check canary evictions last 30m
curl -s "https://logs.redwood.internal/query?service=runtime&tag=canary/prefetch-4&since=30m" | jq '.hits[] | {ts, evictions, latency_p95}'
```
Maria Vega: action items for next oncall: 1) confirm no regressions from prefetch canary by EOD UTC, 2) if eviction rate > 0.5% open a rollback ticket, 3) coordinate with infra to pause heavy batch jobs before maintenance.
Alex Chen: I'll attach the canary release notes to the handoff doc.
Maria Vega: I'll own item 2 for first 2 hours after handoff. Samir can you own number 3?
Samir Patel: will do. Also — mobile SDK tests flaked on truncated responses. I filed issue mobile/422. Not critical but keep an eye for user reports.
Alex Chen: thanks all. leaving docs: https://go/redwood/oncall/handbook/prefetch-2026 and canary dashboard: https://dash/redwood/canary/prefetch-4
Maria Vega: got it. GLHF :thumbsup: 
Samir Patel: thanks — taking over. ping me if anything urgent.
